name: ISO/IEC 42001
description: The international standard for AI management systems (AIMS), specifying requirements and Annex A controls for organizations that develop, provide, or use AI systems.
contentStatusNotice: Control objectives and structure are drawn from ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Annex A, built at the 9 objective level (A.2 through A.10) rather than all 38 individual sub-controls. Purpose, summary, and other narrative content are application-authored.
